InfoPoints.Title: LOADING BAY
InfoPoints.Body: The loading bay is the entry and exit point for all equipment used at a venue. Equipment arrives in trucks and is normally organised in the order that the equipment is needed. The touring crew, who normally travel by tour bus over night from the previous venue, use the loading bay area to organise equipment until it is taken into the venue. The loading bay can often be used to store empty cases to keep the venue free from danger and clutter.
